items.title: Apple (AAPL) Stock Could Be 30% Overvalued Despite Record iPhone Sales

Strong headlines around iPhone demand, AI features and cost discipline are one thing, but long term investors are ultimately paying for Apple’s future cash flows, not just recent share price strength.
